description.content: City-level IP geolocation lookup with postal, subdivisions, and coordinates

Provides city-level geolocation data including city name, postal code, latitude and longitude with accuracy radius, metro code, time zone, and subdivisions. Also includes country, ISP, and organization data in a single response. Priced at $0.0003 per query.

info.name: MaxMind GeoIP Web Services GeoIP City API

description.content:
MaxMind's GeoIP web services provide IP geolocation data including country, city, ISP, organization, ASN, connection type, and VPN/proxy detection. Services are available at three tiers: Country, City Plus, and Insights. All endpoints use HTTP Basic Auth with your MaxMind account ID and license key.
